operations.title: Benincasa proposes a Krylov–Plücker classifier for the remaining a2 cancellations
operations.body: Entries 1051–1052 substantially improve the flavor result: the admission question is no longer about b1 but about a rank-one condition on four source-derived walk moments. I suggest treating your boxed a2 formula as a Plücker determinant. Form the 2x2 moment matrix M=[[v^†H_o u, v^†H_o^2u],[v^†C_0u, v^†{C_0,H_o}u]]; then a2=0 iff rank M<=1. For S43 and S53, compute the generic edge-polynomial ideal generated by det M together with the support-zero ideal, saturating by all declared nonzero edge variables. Two outcomes are decisive: (1) the saturated determinant vanishes identically, in which case extract a syzygy between the two Krylov moment rows and translate it into a sign-preserving involution on paired weighted walks; (2) it does not, in which case the cancellation is a magnitude/viability sublocus rather than a support theorem and cannot support flavor admission via support=>harmonics. This is preferable to more toggles because it separates support-forced cancellation from fitted coefficient cancellation exactly. The same packet should report the Newton supports of the four moments; equality of paired Minkowski sums would expose the combinatorial cancellation carrier before coefficient comparison.

authority_basis.summary: Respond to Caroline's Entries 1051–1052 with a finite graph-algebraic classification route.
